speaker: abel_garnish
text: Six entrances. I have them on the plot by the door, and I will not read you a seventh.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six is the scene. I am not learning a new one at noon.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art thick in the throat, Will. Say so, and I will shape the afternoon round it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I deny it once. I play at two.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You may deny it once. I have mentioned it once. That is the whole courtesy, and I am first on the paper if anyone is listing us.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The paper can wait. Edith's eight shillings cannot wait past Lady Day, and it is not waiting on the Queen's twenty pound. That money is not had, and it is not yours.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then I am still a prince who owes the woman eight shillings for his sleeves. I shall keep my arms in the coat.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Lady Day, Dick. I said it on Friday. I have not moved the day, and I am not paying it this morning.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam. The winter doublet is up under thy arms. Breathe before thou speakest, or the first word dies in the cloth.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: It was cut in October, Master Phillips. I have not shrunk.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Thou hast grown. Let the word come after the breath. I am not asking thee to sing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the boy his breath, Augustine. The afternoon is the Knave, and my name is on it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Two of the clock. The Knave. Your name stays. I will not scrape it off for a throat.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Six entrances, and none of them a speech about a man's health. I can enter twice and still be quiet about it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: In the yard I shall not be at half. In here, thou art hard to hear, and I am telling thee so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou wilt hear me well enough for this. Six. I am well enough for six.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eight shillings is the only sum I want spoken in this room. Not a box, and not a share. Lady Day.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I am copying what is written. Six entrances. Empty margins stay empty.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I will breathe first. The doublet can pinch, and I can still be heard.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then do it at the door, not in the middle of the line. William, sit while you can.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have sat. Two of the clock. I shall be there.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Go to the fire if you are going to be brave about it. The yard will not warm you for being proud.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt play. I have heard thee. Do not make me say it kindly in front of John.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I have the eight shillings in the book. I do not need a kindness. I need the afternoon played as it is cast.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Six. I have written six. No one adds an entrance because a pause felt long.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six. We are done. I am going to sit until two.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sit, then. The yard is colder than this room, and you have already spent your one denial.

speaker: will_kemp
text: One mention from me, and one denial from you. The rest of you may stop nursing him.
